summary: First-pass backend smoke test of KJAPP taxi API. All 11 requested endpoints verified against public backend URL. Auth (register/login/me), places (8 seeded, featured filter), cars/nearby (8 drivers from MongoDB), trip estimate/request/lifecycle (searching -> arrived within ~25s), AI chat (Claude replies in Norwegian), payment methods (Vipps/Visa/Mastercard seeded), and settings GET/PATCH all working correctly.
passed: POST /api/auth/register with {email,password,fullName} returns JWT token+user (id, email, fullName, phone)
POST /api/auth/register duplicate email -> 400 with Norwegian message 'E-post er allerede registrert'
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user; without token -> 401
GET /api/places returns 8 places; ?featured_only=true returns 3 featured places (Karl Johans, Aker Brygge, Oslo S)
POST /api/cars/nearby returns 8 active drivers with lat/lng/eta_min/distance_km computed around requested position
POST /api/trips/estimate returns distance_km, duration_min and 4 options (ai-first, enkelt, trygg, premium) with prices
POST /api/trips/request creates trip (status=searching) with auth; background lifecycle progresses searching -> in_trip -> arrived within ~25s
GET /api/trips/{trip_id} returns current status with driver info assigned from MongoDB drivers collection
GET /api/trips/active returns the active trip for the user (null when none)
POST /api/ai/chat returns Norwegian reply from Claude via emergentintegrations and session_id
GET /api/payment-methods returns 3 seeded methods (Vipps default, Visa, Mastercard) for ola@kjapp.no
GET /api/settings returns defaults (Norsk, Mork, ai_voice Nora); PATCH /api/settings updates language field
notes: Register schema uses 'fullName' (camelCase) not 'name'. Trip request uses 'pickup_address'/'dropoff_address' (not 'pickup_name'). Trip response id field is 'trip_id' (not 'id'). These are schema conventions, not bugs, but frontend must match.
AI chat responded in Norwegian in ~2s. emergentintegrations + Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration is live and working.
